disclaimer: Prototype rule set compiled from the cited regulations and secondary sources on 2026-10-29. Not legal advice: an insurance-law specialist must confirm each rule, and rules change. Business days exclude Saturdays and Sundays only, not public holidays.

acknowledge.summary: Acknowledge notice of claim, provide forms and begin investigating within 15 calendar days.

decide.summary: Accept or deny within 40 calendar days of receiving proof of claim; if more time is needed, give written reasons (and updates every 30 days, § 2695.7(c)(1)).

recovery.summary: Action for injury to property: 3 years.
recovery.verification: background knowledge, not verified against the statute

acknowledge.summary: Acknowledge receipt of notice of claim within 15 business days.

decide.summary: Advise acceptance or rejection in writing within 15 business days after receiving a properly executed proof of loss and all requested items, or notify that more time is needed.

recovery.summary: Action to recover damages for injury to property: 3 years.
recovery.verification: background knowledge, not verified against the statute

acknowledge.summary: Acknowledge the claim, begin investigating and request needed items within 15 days of notice.

decide.summary: Accept or reject in writing within 15 business days of receiving all items required to secure final proof of loss; if more time is needed, decide within 45 days of giving notice of that.

recovery.summary: Action for injury to the property of another: 2 years.

acknowledge.summary: Review and acknowledge receipt of a claim communication within 7 calendar days.

decide.summary: Pay or deny a residential property claim within 60 days of notice of the claim.

recovery.summary: Negligence actions accruing after 24 Mar 2023: 2 years. § 95.11(3)(g) still states 4 years for injury to personal property; the shorter period is used so the recovery right is not lost.

acknowledge.summary: Acknowledge pertinent communications with reasonable promptness: at most 15 working days.

decide.summary: Affirm or deny liability within a reasonable time (no fixed number of days); offer payment within 30 days of affirming liability for undisputed amounts.

recovery.summary: Action to recover damages for injury to property: 5 years.
recovery.verification: background knowledge, not verified against the statute
